basic_details.job_title: AIISH Mysore Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 4 Junior Research Fellow, Senior Research Fellow and More Posts
basic_details.total_vacancies: Senior Research Fellow (SRF), Junior Research Fellow (JRF), Project Assistant, Speech & Hearing Assistant/Technician

application_fee.details: The fee is paid through the BHIM QR code printed in the notification. On the application form, give the Transaction ID/UTR reference number and the date of payment, and attach proof of payment. Applications without the fee, or without a Transaction ID/UTR number, will be rejected.

qualification.details: The upper age limit is counted as on the date of the walk-in interview. The Director may relax the age limit in exceptional circumstances. | Essential Qualification: M.Sc (Audiology)/ MASLP Work Experience: 02 Year experience Desirable: Experience working with electrophysiological measures RCI Registration No. & Validity (If relevant): Yes Languages Known: English & Kannada Nature of Work: Electro physical assessment pre and post speech in noise training in CI users | Essential Qualification: M.Sc (Audiology) or Equivalent with atleast 55% marks Desirable: Publications related to psychoacoustics and/or speech perception in peer-reviewed journals; basic knowledge of signal processing in MATLAB, Python etc. RCI Registration No. & Validity (If relevant): Yes Languages Known: English & Kannada (Preferred) Nature of Work: Data Collection, analysis report writing & Publications | Essential Qualification: Three year Diploma from a recognized Institution/Board in Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE)/Computer Science Engineering (CSE)/Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE)/ Mechatronics/Automation and Robotics/ Information Science & Engineering OR Diploma in Hearing Language and Speech (DHLS)/ Diploma in Hearing Aid and Ear Mould Technology (DHA&ET) Languages Known: Any Language Nature of Work: Conduct nationwide acoustic noise data collection and recording in diverse environments, ensuring accurate measurement, documentation, quality control, database management, and technical support for project research activities | Essential Qualification: Minimum diploma in the field of Speech and Hearing [DHLS/DHA & ET/DECSE(HI) or equivalent] or equivalent relevant field Work Experience: No prior work experience is mandatory Preferred: Basic computer skills and experience in audio recording, data entry/documentation, or research-related activities RCI Registration No. & Validity (If relevant): Yes Languages Known: Proficiency in any language is acceptable Nature of Work: Assisting in infant cry data collection and documentation, clinical assessment and related research activities, data entry and database maintenance, and collecting and organising research data. The candidate will have to travel to hospitals/clinical centres for data collection, help the research team with project-related activities and prepare reports, presentations and other research documentation. | The essential qualifications are only the minimum. Having them does not by itself entitle a candidate to be considered. Candidates should list all the qualifications and experience they hold in the relevant field. Rehabilitation professionals must hold a valid registration with RCI wherever applicable. AIISH M.Sc. students who are still in their bond period will not be considered for any of these projects. | The official notification gives the full eligibility for each post.

selection_process: Candidates are selected on their performance in the walk-in interview and on the needs of the particular project. The Selection Committee's decision is final
and no changes will be considered after the final selection. Candidates can take part in person at the venue or virtually.
how_to_apply: Download the application form (Appendix-1, "Application Form for DST/ARF/ALIMCO Project Positions") from www.aiishmysore.in. It is also printed in the official notification.
Fill in the form and paste a recent self-attested passport-size photograph. To apply for more than one post, list them in order of preference with their post codes.
Pay the fee by BHIM QR code and enter the Transaction ID/UTR, payment date and amount in the box on the form.

To attend in person, bring the form and self-attested copies of your certificates to the Dean (Research) cell, COE building, All India Institute of Speech and Hearing, Mysore, on 5 November 2026. Submit the application before 9.30 AM. The interview starts at 10.30 AM.
To attend virtually, email a soft copy of the filled-in form and all supporting documents to [email protected] before 04:00 PM on 4 November 2026.
Educational certificates: all semester marks lists, the degree certificate and the Master Degree certificate
Experience certificates, if needed (experience without a certificate will not be counted)
A percentage conversion certificate from the university or college, if your marks are given as CGPA
Proof of payment of the application fee

Applications without a photograph, a signature or the necessary certificates will be rejected outright. The form also asks for two professional references, details of professional memberships and awards, a note of up to 100 words on why you suit the post, and how soon you can join.
AIISH will not answer emails or phone calls about the recruitment. Updates will only be posted on the institute's website.

content_sections.heading: About AIISH
content_sections.text: The All India Institute of Speech and Hearing is an autonomous body under the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India. It is located at Manasagangothri, Mysore – 570 006, and its phone numbers are 0821-2502000 and 2502100. The institute's Dean (Research) cell is running this recruitment for its funded research projects.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is paid through the BHIM QR code printed in the notification. In the payment remarks or purpose of the transaction, write "Application fee for the post of ..." and "Application fee for the post code ...". On the application form, give the Transaction ID/UTR reference number and the date of payment, and attach proof of payment. Applications without the fee, or without a Transaction ID/UTR number, will be rejected.

rows.event: Submission of application at the venue

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected on their performance in the walk-in interview and on the needs of the particular project. The Selection Committee's decision is final, and no changes will be considered after the final selection. Candidates can take part in person at the venue or virtually.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The place of work is AIISH, Mysore, for the SRF, JRF and Speech & Hearing Assistant/Technician posts. The Project Assistant's work involves collecting acoustic data across the country. All posts are contractual. Being engaged in one of these posts gives no right or claim to a permanent appointment at the institute. The competent authority may accept or reject any application without giving reasons, and may decide not to fill all or any of the posts. Canvassing in any form, or bringing in political or other influence, will lead to disqualification.

rows.tenure_of_engagement: 15 months (initially 6 months, extendable for another 9 months depending on the outcome of the interim project report)

faq.question: Q1. Where is the AIISH walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: The interview is at the Dean (Research) cell, COE building, All India Institute of Speech and Hearing, Mysore. It starts at 10.30 AM on 5 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Can I attend the interview online?
faq.answer: Yes. Email the filled-in form and supporting documents to [email protected] before 04:00 PM on 4 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. By what time must I submit my form at the venue?
faq.answer: Submit it before 9.30 AM on the interview day, which is an hour before the interview begins.

faq.question: Q4. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes. Write each post and its post code (1 to 4) in your order of preference on the hard copy of the form. You can list up to four.

faq.question: Q5. Which posts can diploma holders apply for?
faq.answer: The Project Assistant post accepts a three-year diploma in ECE, CSE, EEE, Mechatronics, Automation and Robotics or Information Science, or a DHLS or DHA&ET diploma. The Speech & Hearing Assistant/Technician post accepts DHLS, DHA & ET, DECSE(HI) or an equivalent diploma.

faq.question: Q6. How much does the SRF post pay in total?
faq.answer: The SRF post pays a consolidated Rs. 42,000/- a month plus HRA at 20%. No other allowances are paid.

faq.question: Q7. Do I need work experience for the Speech & Hearing Assistant/Technician post?
faq.answer: No. Preference goes to candidates with basic computer skills and experience in audio recording, data entry or research work.

faq.question: Q8. How do I pay the application fee?
faq.answer: Pay using the BHIM QR code in the notification. General, OBC and EWS candidates pay ₹140/- and SC/ST candidates pay ₹60/-. Women and PwBD candidates do not pay a fee. Write the Transaction ID/UTR number on the form.

faq.question: Q9. Can AIISH M.Sc. students who are under bond apply?
faq.answer: No. AIISH M.Sc. students still in their bond period will not be considered for any of these projects.

faq.question: Q10. Can the Speech & Hearing Assistant/Technician contract be extended?
faq.answer: Yes. The post starts with 6 months and can be extended by 9 more months, depending on the outcome of the interim project report.
